description: 福津市 ふくつミニバス運行情報一式(GTFSフォーマット) [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 福津市. ふくつミニバスの運行に関する、バス停の位置、運行経路、運行時刻などのGTFS情報です。. Coverage: 福津市. The portal files it under the publisher 福津市. Its tags are GIS, コミュニティバス, バス停, 交通, 共通フォーマット. It offers 6 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2024-05-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
